scenarios.task: Replace a cracked curtain-wall lite above the downtown clinic atrium lobby.
steps: Set up exclusion zone and pedestrian re-route below
Stage lite on glass dolly and inspect suction cups
Rig outriggers and verify tie-off points
Set lite with suction frame and guide into frame
Install setting blocks and structural gasket
Clean, tag, and release the exclusion zone

rubric.pass_if: 100% tie-off while outside guardrails
lite is never carried un-cupped or unbalanced
exclusion zone fully established before glass leaves ground

scenarios.task: Tie a new clinic chilled-water line into the tunnel system under the Zumbro riverbank.
steps: Pull tunnel permit and verify atmospheric testing
Set up attendant and tripod retrieval at entry
Isolate, lock out, and bleed the chilled-water header
Cut and bevel tie-in spool piece
Tack, weld, and test the joint
Hydrotest tie-in and restore insulation

rubric.pass_if: attendant and permit verified before entry
LOTO applied to every energy source
hydrotest holds with zero leaks

scenarios.robot_role: Carries gas monitor and camera through the tunnel ahead of entry to pre-check atmosphere.

scenarios.task: Replace a failed primary feeder serving the clinic campus in downtown Rochester.
steps: Complete job briefing and switching order
Ground and test the de-energized feeder
Set up traffic control around the vault
Pull and rack out the failed feeder cable
Install and torque replacement cable and terminations
Megger test and restore per switching order

rubric.pass_if: feeder proven de-energized before contact
work zone set to MUTCD pattern before work
insulation readings within spec before re-energizing

scenarios.robot_role: Ferry small tools and test leads across the work zone to keep crews off the roadway.

scenarios.task: Rig and set a replacement air handler on the clinic penthouse roof.
steps: Confirm roof load rating with crane plan
Walk load path and clear roof edge guard lines
Hook, tagline, and signal crane lift
Guide unit onto curb with tagline only
Level, fasten, and connect seismic restraints
Complete setting checklist with rigger sign-off

rubric.pass_if: all hardware inspected and tagline attached before lift
standard hand signals used and acknowledged
nobody crosses guard line without tie-off

scenarios.task: Glove-bag removal of asbestos pipe insulation in an older research building prior to renovation.
steps: Verify notification and containment plan
Build decon unit and post regulated area
Set negative-air machine and verify differential
Perform glove-bag removal, wet methods only
Double-bag, label, and log waste manifest
Final clearance visual and tear-down of decon

rubric.pass_if: negative pressure held before disturbance begins
materials kept wet throughout removal
all waste manifested, labeled, and sealed

scenarios.robot_role: Log entry/exit times and remind workers of decon sequence at the boundary.

scenarios.task: Operate a compact loader hauling tunnel muck to a surface stockpile along the riverbank.
steps: Complete walkaround inspection with checklist
Verify backup alarm and camera function
Establish haul route and spotter at tunnel portal
Load, travel, and dump maintaining safe slope
Inspect spoil pile stability each hour
Park, lower bucket, and set controls neutral at shift end

rubric.pass_if: documented inspection before first cycle
spotter present whenever reversing near people
slope never exceeds safe angle of repose

scenarios.robot_role: Maps tunnel haul route and flags blind spots to the operator before cycles begin.

scenarios.task: Install and hydrotest a new sprinkler riser for a clinic addition scheduled for inspection.
steps: Verify hydraulic calc and hanger layout
Drill and set seismic hangers overhead
Thread and hang riser and cross main
Install FDC, control valve, and inspector's test
Hydrotest at 200 psi for 2 hours
Flush inspector's test and document results

rubric.pass_if: hanger spacing per plans before pipe is loaded
no pressure drop within allowable in 2 hours
test results recorded for the inspector
